Trump switched planes in Turkey due to Iran missile threat, reports say

Former U.S. President Donald Trump secretly switched to a smaller aircraft while departing Turkey last month due to a missile threat from Iran, according to multiple reports. The larger presidential plane was reportedly used as a decoy. Trump confirmed the Secret Service and military recommended the move, citing a threat. Iran's state media and social media users ridiculed the incident, with some memes depicting Trump hidden in a catering truck. The threat was reportedly relayed to the CIA by the Israeli government, though one report suggested the CIA did not find the threat compelling enough before the switch.
